name: Conventions screen reaches the never-scanned empty state from the sidebar
description: The Conventions screen is reachable from the SKILLS LAB sidebar section and, on a freshly-seeded stack where no extraction has ever run, renders the never-scanned empty state with its Run extraction call to action. The flow deliberately stops before running an extraction: a scan calls a model, and this suite has no keys and must stay deterministic (see e2e/AGENTS.md). What is asserted here is the route, the heading and the empty state — the pipeline itself is covered by server/test/conventions.it.test.ts against a mock provider. Assumes the freshly-seeded hermetic stack — see e2e/README.md.

steps.label: land on the PR list so the active repo is resolved
open Conventions from the SKILLS LAB sidebar section
the page heading names the active repo
the never-scanned empty state is shown
